default/30655.htm.text: Isael Silvershadow: May the blessings of the starlight shine upon you. Hello, young traveler. Welcome to the Hunters Village. My name is Isael Silvershadow. I am a Knight of the Order of the Rose, who once fought alongside Grand Master Hannavalt. But now I am retired and live a quiet life here.

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-01.htm.text: Isael Silvershadow: May the blessing of the starlight be with you. Welcome to the Hunters Village! I'd love to welcome you here... or ask you to tell me your stories, but... circumstance forces me not to do any of that.

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-00.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: There's something putting me in a difficult situation. But it is too dangerous to ask you to take on the job. Get some more experience first. (Only characters at level 80 or higher can perform the quest.)

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-07.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Valley Trader Kitzka is in the Dragon Valley. Again, it is a very dangerous place, so I recommend you go there with your colleagues. May the Saiha of Wind guide you to a safe journey...

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-08.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: You are back! Now, I apologize for testing you, but I couldn't find someone trustworthy for my task. Thank you for all your help! (You have already completed this quest.)

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30655-01.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Hello, young knight. May you be blessed by starlight. Welcome to the Hunters Village. True to Hannavalt's words, you have the talent to become a great Knight, but you are not quite ready this task. Please continue your training.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30655-02.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: May the blessings of the starlight shine upon you. Hello, young warrior. Welcome to the Hunters Village. True to Hannavalt's words, you seem to have the potential to become a great Knight someday. Let's briefly discuss the last virtue of a Knight, loyalty. Loyalty may be towards…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30655-03.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: The hour of the memorial service draws near. We must have the personal articles of the guards from the Leto Lizardmen for the ceremony. We need about 20 pieces of the articles. Thank you for your assistance in this matter. Leto Lizardmen can be found on the Plains of the Lizardm…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30655-04.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Well done! The guards' families will be eternally grateful for your services. The representative of the families has asked me to present you with this jewel. It is called the Tear of Loyalty . Grand Master Hannavalt has requested that you go to Father Dustin in the Town of Giran…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30655-05.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: You must proceed with haste to Father Dustin in the Town of Giran . He is preparing the last trial that you must face. With your admirable skills you should pass this test easily. I wish you luck.

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30655-01.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: I understand that Thalia has sent you to retrieve Talin's Spear , 1 of the 4 great Elven treasures. This is a serious matter indeed. It must be recovered at once! The scout troop of the hunter's association has discovered the whereabouts of the spear.

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30655-04.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: You have found all of the pieces of Talin's spear! Reassembling this will be easy for me! I studied the art of weaponry with Hierarch Terestian of the lake fairies. Now! Take this spear and return to Thalia . Please find the Water of Life so that the Mother Tree may become green…

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30655-03.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Please, you must hurry and find the blade, shaft, and four jewels of Talin's Spear that were stolen from us by the Leto Lizardman Shamans and Chiefs . Time is of the essence. May Sayha of the winds guide your footsteps...

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-02.htm.text: Isael Silvershadow: There's something putting me in a difficult situation. I have a favor to ask, but it is a request that I would not ask of someone without skills, and someone I didn't deem trustworthy. I believe that you may be qualified to do the job...

links.text: "I'd like to hear more about it."

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-03.htm.text: Isael Silvershadow: In fact, you should deliver a Special Item to the Dragon valley. The atmosphere there has been changed, so the porters are refusing to deliver it even under double pay. Nevertheless, I have contracts with the merchants in the valley, so have no choice but to deliver the thing. I…

links.text: "Well, what is the favor that you wanted to ask me?"

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-04.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Okay. He'd like you to deliver this to Valley Trader Kitzka . He's staying in the Dragon Valley. Once you deliver the item, you will receive your wages from him. How about it?

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-05.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: But, please promise one thing before you receive the item. Promise that you will never covet the item . If you swear to it, I will give you the item now. And I, too, pledge my honor as a knight that I will remember the trust and effort you have shown me.

Q00026_TiredOfWaiting/30655-06.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: Thank you for your trust. Valley Trader Kitzka is in the Dragon Valley. It is too dangerous to secure your safety there, so it might be a good idea for you to travel with a colleague you can trust. Safe trip, friend - may Saiha of Wind guide you to a safe journey...

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30655-02.html.text: Isael Silvershadow: It was the Leto Lizardmen who wrested the spear from the lake fairies. It is said that the Shamans and Chiefs of their group broke the spear into many pieces and divided them among themselves. The spear was divided into six pieces: the blade, the shaft, and four jewels that ador…
